kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أستدفئ (form X)
# أَسْتَدْفِئُ (ʔastadfiʔu) /ʔas.tad.fi.ʔu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَدْفَأَ (istadfaʔa)
# أَسْتَدْفِئَ (ʔastadfiʔa) /ʔas.tad.fi.ʔa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَدْفَأَ (istadfaʔa)
# أَسْتَدْفِئْ (ʔastadfiʔ) /ʔas.tad.fiʔ/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِسْتَدْفَأَ (istadfaʔa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
